title: The Brood of Kessar

objectives.text: Land on Kessar IV (star map, cockpit)
Find the hive entrance on the Ashfall Flats
comms: [OVERWATCH] You're down. The mining camp should be close; see if their logs say where they were digging.
[OVERWATCH] Watch the ash, Operative. The survey drone stopped transmitting somewhere around here.
[OVERWATCH] That's a nest if I ever saw one. Go down and find what's laying the eggs.
[OVERWATCH] Readings are off the scale further in. Whatever's in charge down there, it's big.

objectives.text: Return to the ship (Recall, or the landing shuttle)
comms: [OVERWATCH] Confirmed kill. The swarm's losing its mind without her. Recall to the ship and report in.

debrief: [OVERWATCH] Kessar IV is quiet again. Good work, Operative. Bounty's in your account.
[OVERWATCH] There's a refinery in the Kessar belt that's started talking to itself. It's on your star map.
